valuation_philosophy: FCF-based DCF with 5-year explicit projection period. ENSG is valued on free cash flow given its acquisition-driven growth model. Equity CAGR (22.2% 5yr) is inflated by retained earnings from 71+ facilities added since 2025 and is not used as the primary growth anchor. Base FCF growth of 14% (Y1) decelerating to 6% (Y5) reflects company FY2026 guidance (~15% revenue growth) tempered by integration drag from newly acquired facilities. Bear case materially incorporates the June 2026 Hunterbrook and Muddy Waters short-seller allegations, including potential False Claims Act liability (Muddy Waters est. 35% EBIT reduction) and OBBB Medicaid headwinds.

inputs.data_source: Q1-2026 balance sheet (latest row in ENSG_Metrics.csv)

historical_growth.growth_rate_rationale: Equity 5yr CAGR (22.2%) is inflated by acquisition-retained earnings from 71+ facilities added since 2025 and overstates sustainable organic growth. FCF 5yr CAGR (2.8%) is depressed by a COVID-distorted FY2020 base ($323M in one-time relief payments). Y1 base growth of 14% is calibrated to company FY2026 guidance ($5.81-5.86B revenue, ~15% growth; EPS midpoint ~15% growth) with slight FCF lag from integration costs. Revenue and EPS 5yr CAGRs (16.1% and 13.5%) bracket the selection.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_detail: No automatic 30pp divergence flag triggered. Equity vs Revenue 5yr divergence = 6.2pp (OK). Equity vs EPS 5yr divergence = 8.7pp (OK). Manual override applied to equity CAGR due to acquisition distortion; blended anchor used instead.

base.description: Continued acquisition playbook at moderating pace. FCA allegations not substantiated at material scale but create a modest regulatory drag. OBBB causes incremental Medicaid headwind from 2028 onward. FCF margins stable at ~7-8%. Acquisition pace slows toward 30-40 facilities per year as integration catches up.

bull.description: Short-seller allegations proven unfounded. Acquisition flywheel accelerates with $1.13B+ liquidity deployed. Skilled mix continues improving toward 35%+ of revenue days. Standard Bearer REIT creates incremental value and rental income grows 25%+. Occupancy reaches 86%+ across the portfolio. Margin expansion from integration maturity outpaces wage inflation.

bear.description: DOJ or OIG opens formal FCA investigation following Muddy Waters administrator-license allegations. Ensign required to remediate staffing at 20+ facilities (estimated 35% EBIT reduction per Muddy Waters). Securities fraud class action settled. OBBB materially impairs Medicaid reimbursement rates affecting 44.6% of revenue. Texas geographic concentration exposes outsized single-state regulatory risk. Acquisition pace slows sharply as management attention diverts to regulatory defense. Near-term FCF compressed; recovery modest through FY2031.

sensitivity.note: Rows = WACC (8-12%), Cols = Terminal Growth Rate (2-4%). Uses base-case FCF growth rates. Current price $163.05 is above all base-case matrix cells, meaning even at the most optimistic base-case WACC/terminal growth (8% / 4%), fair value is $217.70 - only 33% above current price. Bull case is needed to justify current price, which requires resolution of regulatory uncertainty.

probability_weighted.weight_rationale: Bear weight increased to 30% (vs typical 25%) to reflect elevated tail risk from June 2026 Hunterbrook and Muddy Waters reports, active securities fraud investigations by 7+ law firms, and potential DOJ/OIG FCA inquiry. Bull weight reduced to 20% from typical 25% pending regulatory clarity. Weights will update as regulatory situation develops.

sanity_check.methodology: Implied forward multiples at each scenario's intrinsic value were computed against FY2026 estimates (EPS ~$7.55 adj midpoint per guidance, EBITDA ~$620M, FCF ~$423M) and compared to ENSG's historical trading range observed in Metrics.csv data (FY2015-FY2025).

historical_multiple_ranges.pe_range_observed: 15x-30x (observed FY2020-FY2025 based on reported net income and market prices)

base.assessment: PASS - all multiples within historical range. Represents a moderate de-rating from current levels, appropriate given regulatory uncertainty.

bull.assessment: PASS - multiples at high end of historical range, appropriate for bull scenario with continued outperformance and regulatory clearance.

bear.assessment: INTENTIONAL DISTRESS - multiples below normal historical range are appropriate. Muddy Waters estimated ~35% EBIT reduction plus up to $7B theoretical FCA sanctions. At those earnings levels, actual normalized P/E on depressed EPS could still be 15x; the apparent 9.6x reflects current guidance EPS being materially impaired in this scenario. No correction applied - bear multiples are internally consistent with the scenario thesis.

sanity_check.key_observation: Current price ($163.05) implies ~21.6x forward P/E on FY2026 guidance, sitting 20% above the base-case intrinsic value of $130.28. The market appears to be pricing in continued flawless execution with minimal FCA discount. Base-case IV implies a de-rating to ~17x forward P/E - a 4-turn compression that is well within historical precedent for ENSG and consistent with elevated regulatory uncertainty. No assumptions were auto-corrected as all scenario multiples are defensible.

risk_flags.description: Hunterbrook (June 8, 2026) and Muddy Waters (June 11, 2026) published detailed negative reports. 7+ law firms (Pomerantz, Kessler Topaz, Robbins Geller, Levi & Korsinsky, BFA Law, Lowey Dannenberg, Hagens Berman) launched securities fraud investigations. No formal company rebuttal confirmed as of June 27, 2026. Stock has fallen ~8%+ from pre-report levels.
risk_flags.impact_on_dcf: Bear case WACC increased to 12% (from 11% in prior model), bear growth compressed to 2-5%, bear scenario weight increased to 30%.

risk_flags.description: Muddy Waters estimates up to $7B theoretical FCA sanctions and 35% EBIT reduction from alleged administrator-license fraud at approximately 20 facilities. Investigators visited 57 of 379 facilities across 8 states; found red flags at 12 (21%). DOJ/OIG investigation not yet confirmed but risk is material and non-zero.
risk_flags.impact_on_dcf: Captured structurally in bear scenario assumptions. A standalone FCA settlement of $500M-$3B would reduce equity value by approximately $8-$50 per share, depending on settlement size and operational remediation costs. This is not modeled as a single-event deduction but embedded in the bear case growth and margin compression.

risk_flags.description: One Big Beautiful Bill (signed July 2025) reduces federal Medicaid contributions starting FY2030, caps state-directed payments, imposes provider tax moratorium, and tightens eligibility. Affects approximately 44.6% of revenue. Full impact is phased 2027-2030 and state-specific.
risk_flags.impact_on_dcf: Reflected in base case with 3.0% terminal growth (vs potential 3.5%+ without OBBB) and in bear case as primary driver of post-Y2 growth compression to 2%.

warning_banner.title: Elevated Uncertainty - Active Short-Seller Investigations (June 2026)
warning_banner.message: This DCF was prepared after Hunterbrook Capital (June 8, 2026) and Muddy Waters Research (June 11, 2026) published highly critical reports alleging quality-metric gaming, patient care failures, and administrator-license fraud at Ensign facilities. Multiple securities fraud law firm investigations are active. The company had not issued a formal public rebuttal as of June 27, 2026. The base-case intrinsic value of $130.28 and probability-weighted IV of $124.87 are both materially below the current price of $163.05, suggesting the market has not fully priced in downside scenarios. The wide IV range ($72.58 bear to $189.80 bull) reflects genuine binary uncertainty around the regulatory outcome. This model should not be read as a buy signal.

analyst_notes.valuation_summary: ENSG trades at $163.05 post-June 2026 short-seller reports, above both the base case IV ($130.28) and probability-weighted IV ($124.87), implying 20-23% downside on a risk-adjusted basis. The bull case ($189.80) is the only scenario with positive upside (16.4%), requiring regulatory clearance AND continued execution. Prior February 2026 model used equity CAGR as growth anchor; this revision uses a guided-growth anchor more appropriate given the investigation environment.
key_changes_from_prior_model: Current price updated to $163.05 (was $176.59 in Feb 2026 model)
Shares updated to 59.6M from 59.5M Q1-2026 actual (was 58.1M FY2025)
Net debt updated to -$398.7M from Q1-2026 balance sheet (cash $539.5M, debt $140.8M)
Growth anchor changed from equity CAGR (22.2%) to guided-growth blended anchor (14% Y1) reflecting more conservative stance post-short-seller reports
Bear case materially upgraded: WACC raised 12% (from 11%), bear growth reduced to 2-5% (from 3-10%), incorporates FCA risk as primary driver
Bear scenario probability weight increased to 30% (from 25%) due to active investigations
Bull scenario probability weight reduced to 20% (from 30%)
Sanity check block and warning banner added per Step 8c requirements
key_value_drivers: Acquisition execution: 71 facilities added since start of 2025, with $1.13B total liquidity ($539.5M cash + $591.6M credit) available for continued M&A. Historical playbook improves EBITDAR from ~13% at acquisition to ~19% by month 45.
Occupancy recovery: Same-facility occupancy reached record 84.3% in Q1 2026 (up 2.3% YoY). Path to 86-87% represents meaningful earnings upside.
Skilled mix: 32.0% of days (50.7% of revenue) in Q1 2026, continuing to improve. Higher-acuity patients drive better revenue per patient day.
Standard Bearer REIT: 179 owned properties as of May 2026, with FY2025 FFO up 33.9% YoY. Real estate portfolio underpins balance sheet and acquisition strategy.
Demographic tailwinds: 65+ population growing 24% by 2030 vs 3% overall. Structural demand driver independent of short-term regulatory noise.
key_risks: FCA and securities fraud investigation: Existential tail risk if DOJ opens formal inquiry. Muddy Waters theoretical max $7B sanctions exceeds current market cap.
OBBB Medicaid impact: Federal contribution cuts, state-directed payment caps, and provider tax restrictions affect 44.6% of revenue starting 2027-2030.
Integration capacity: 71 facilities in 18 months is the most aggressive acquisition pace in company history; each depresses margins for 12-18 months.
Labor cost inflation: 60% of expenses are payroll-related; any mandated staffing remediation from regulatory findings would significantly compress margins.
Multiple compression risk: Even at 21.6x forward P/E (post-decline), market has embedded a premium that is vulnerable to further guidance reductions or investigation escalation.

scenario_probabilities.base_scenario: 50% - Moderate regulatory friction but no material FCA liability, continued but moderating growth, stable margins
scenario_probabilities.bear_scenario: 30% - FCA/OIG formal inquiry materializes, staffing remediation required, OBBB materially impairs Medicaid rates, securities litigation settlement
